purpose: Original material library for Civ V-style outpost source meshes
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL material texture atlas for low-poly Civilization V outpost models, NOT a picture of an outpost.
Use the attached stock Civilization V diffuse atlases only as references for restrained color, weathering, dark crevices and hand-painted material treatment. Do not copy any existing layout, structure, pixels, symbols or architecture. Create new generic building materials.

Output one SQUARE, front-facing, evenly divided 5-column by 5-row texture atlas with exactly 25 equal square regions, no gaps, no borders, no labels or text. Each region is a flat surface sample filling its entire square, viewed straight on, with no perspective or objects. Precisely uniform grid spacing is essential for UV mapping.
The 25 regions in row-major order MUST be:
Row 1: weathered grey cut stone blocks; pale aged limestone blocks; dull brown-red small bricks; dark rough oak planks; lighter aged wood planks.
Row 2: tightly packed straw thatch; dark blue-grey slate shingles; faded terracotta roof tiles; dull weathered green copper sheet; mottled aged grey military concrete.
Row 3: muted olive painted steel; dull dark gunmetal steel; almost-black desaturated blue window glass; muted dusty blue canvas; charred dark wood.
Row 4: khaki coarse sandbag fabric; grey corrugated metal roofing; subdued dark navy photovoltaic cells with very thin fine grid; broken grey-beige stone rubble; weathered warm off-white plaster.
Row 5: khaki stone-filled metal gabion mesh; dusty compact earth; neutral aged stone; dark grey plain metal; light weathered grey plaster.

Stylistic target: the subdued textured realism of 2010 Civilization V terrain improvements. Color must be muted, natural, earthy. Small irregularities, age stains, subtle edge highlights and narrow dark joints, broad soft material variation. Keep diffuse lighting neutral enough for 3D shading. The individual material samples have rich subtle tonal detail, never thick cartoon outlines, thick black mortar grids, clean flat blocks or bright toy colors. No black empty regions. No glossy PBR showroom appearance, no dramatic cast shadows. Stones and bricks should be many small elements per square: brick about 14 columns and 22 rows, stone about 8 columns and 12 rows. Wood grain and roof shingles fine but readable. No buildings, typography, landscape, watermarks or UI.
reference_assets: Installed Fort_MID_DIFF, Fort_MOD_DIFF and Citadel_Anc_DIFF: visual reference only, not copied into deliverables.
